description: Imputed alcohol (alcohol_im) by fatal status, police-reported vs imputed records
population: CRSS police-reported crashes (all severities, national probability sample) with a determinable maximum severity (fatal: MAXSEV_IM 9 excluded; ka: MAXSEV_IM 5 and 9 excluded, so ka rows are a subset); train 2016-2021, validation 2022, test 2023-2024
method: Weighted P(alcohol_im = yes) among fatal and non-fatal training crashes, separately where police-reported alcohol is known and where it was imputed; fatal metrics use every crash with a known fatal outcome; ka metrics use only the crashes where ka is known (MAXSEV_IM 5 and 9 excluded), so the two outcomes differ in n
